idea: How to prevent bad smells from drains
title: Fresh Sinks, Happy Homes: Easy Drain Odor Prevention
description: Unpleasant drain odors are usually caused by trapped food debris, dried-out P-traps, or a buildup of grease and soap scum. To keep your kitchen and bathroom drains smelling fresh, try flushing them weekly with hot water to wash away soft residue. For guest bathrooms or rarely used sinks, run the tap for a few seconds every week to ensure the water barrier in the P-trap stays full and blocks sewer gases. Avoid pouring grease or harsh chemical cleaners down your pipes, as these can create stubborn blockages and damage plumbing over time. If persistent odors continue despite routine care, contact a licensed plumber to inspect your ventilation or main line.
